adaptations.recommendation: Untrusted PR analysis/checks receive minimal read token, no provider secrets or protected runner; do not execute PR code in pull_request_target/workflow_run. Keep agent provider call in a separate trusted-source workflow.

Borrow read-only agent plus sanitized typed safe-output architecture; validate JSON/code patches before a separate narrow writer creates a branch/PR. No inference that gh-aw natively supports this OpenRouter model.

MR workflow rules, protected scoped tokens/runner separation, nonprivileged isolated runner where possible, and serialized sensitive jobs via resource_group; local server/runner existence and registration must be measured separately.

Use exact dated model ID, reasoning.effort=high, require supported parameters, explicit budget/routing price ceilings and actual usage.cost reconciliation; no silent substitute. Model catalog GET is not an authenticated inference test.

Bind identity and authorization, negotiate actual protocol version, exhaust tools/list pagination, inspect schemas/annotations, then make a narrow typed read probe. Annotations alone cannot grant permissions or prove read-only behavior.
